# osifont

Unmodified CAD font, source and MANUAL from https://github.com/hikikomori82/osifont
Revision: 53d85f70f053abf099dc3b5b8c6444bb02044451 (includes Russian Cyrillic).
License: GPL-3.0 with font exception, reproduced in MANUAL; full GPL in ../COPYING.
The editable FontForge source is osifont.sfd. No glyph modifications.

Used as an explicitly labelled substitute for unavailable GOST/ISO/SHX fonts,
not an exact copy of those fonts. The font stays local to this website.
